8.6.3.21 EventStatus
[SWS_Dem_00838] Definition of ClientServerInterface EventStatus ⌈
Name
EventStatus
Comment
Provides the capability modify the event status. One port of this interface type is provided per
application-related diagnostic event by the Dem Service Component. It has EventId as a
port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
–
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
